description: This script checks whether a certain feature (specifically LSA) is enabled based on various configuration sources such as ini files and filesystem presence. It includes functions to log activity, retrieve configuration flags, and interpret their values.

methods.name: ifeLogging
methods.description: Logs messages to the rfcscript.log file with a timestamp and tag.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given feature is enabled by inspecting RFC configurations and the existence of a specific file.
